body.name: Primitive \(C^2\) boundary class
body.construction: \(\mathcal P_{C^2}=\{P:B\geq1,\ X\in[0,1],\ f_X(x)=x^{\kappa-1}\ell(x),\ \int_0^1x^{\kappa-1}\ell(x)dx=1,\ e(x)=xg(x),\ \ell,g,\mu_0,\mu_1\text{ obey the displayed }C^2\text{ and separation conditions, }\mathcal L_P(Y\mid A=a,X=x)=\operatorname{Bernoulli}[(1-a)\mu_0(x)+a\mu_1(x)]\text{ on support }\{0,1\}\subset[-B,B]\text{ for }a\in\{0,1\},\text{ and the displayed sampling and causal conditions hold}\}\) for every \(n\geq1\).
